questions.prompt: Why can the projectile travel farther horizontally while taking nearly the same time to hit the ground?

feedback.whenCorrect: Well done! Your answers show a clear understanding of independent motion components.
feedback.whenIncorrect: Sideways speed does not change fall time; more sideways speed covers more distance in the same time.
feedback.source: teacher-authored explanation based on question-bank answer

questions.answerReference:
a. Gravity stops acting when horizontal speed increases.
b. The projectile has less mass at higher speed.
*c. Horizontal and vertical motion are independent, so greater horizontal velocity covers more distance during the same fall time.
d. Horizontal velocity turns into vertical velocity during flight.

questions.prompt: Write a conclusion in three short parts. (1) Range: compare at least two measured Part A ranges and their horizontal launch speeds.
